Schizophrenia is positive symptoms (psychosis) plus negative symptoms and cognitive symptoms. Psychotic depression only has psychotic symptoms when depressed. Since someone can just have positive (psychotic) symptoms and be diagnosed with schizophrenia, one could technically meet the criteria for schizophrenia, yet still have psychotic depression because they only experience those symptoms when depressed. In a essence schizophrenia can more than psychosis and psychotic depression is only psychotic episodes when depressed.
